say:1:1322127001:1.text: Oh, Carolina's tomb has been sealed!
say:1:1322127001:1.source_cn: 呀，卡列琳娜的坟墓……也被封印了！

say:2:1322127002:1.text: It seems telling them about Carolina last time had the exact opposite effect of what we hoped for...
say:2:1322127002:1.source_cn: 看来上次告诉他们谈过卡列琳娜的事情之后，反而出现了和预...

say:3:1322127003:1.text: How could the acolytes treat the tomb of the deceased like this?! Thankfully, it's just a seal and didn't damage the tomb itself, but still!
say:3:1322127003:1.source_cn: 圣职者怎么可以这样对待亡者的坟墓呢？！还好只是封印，并...

say:4:1322127004:1.text: Don't worry. This is just temporary. Eventually, they'll come to understand us Graveborn in time.
say:4:1322127004:1.source_cn: 别担心，我相信这只是暂时的……最终他们一定会愿意重新去...

say:5:1322127005:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help with this seal as well. After that, we can talk to the two acolytes you're acquainted with...
say:5:1322127005:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help with this seal as well. After that, we can talk to the two acolytes you're acquainted with...
say:5:1322127005:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please help with this seal as well. After that, we can talk to the two acolytes you're acquainted with...

narration:6:1322127006:1.text: Once certain no one is nearby, you quietly unravel the seal with practiced ease. The magic that might awe others is nothing more than a simple task in your capable hands.
